map.计算车辆装载的体积利用率与重量利用率，判断是体积受限还是重量受限，并估算可装载件: Compute a vehicle's volume and weight utilization to judge whether volume or weight is the binding constraint, and estimate the piece count that fits.
map.最大可装件数（体积侧）：对 3 种正交摆放取向 (长,宽,高)、(长,高,宽)、: Maximum piece count (volume side): for the 3 orthogonal orientations (length, width, height), (length, height, width), (width, height, length), compute floor(car length ÷ first side) × floor(car width ÷ second side) × floor(car height ÷ third side) and take the largest of the three as the volume ceiling.
map.重量约束与受限类型判定：受重量限制的最大件数=floor(车辆载重÷单件重量)，: Weight constraint and binding type: maximum pieces by weight = floor(vehicle payload ÷ unit weight), and final maximum pieces = min(volume ceiling, weight ceiling). When the volume ceiling is at most the weight ceiling it is 'volume limited', otherwise 'weight limited', which decides the optimization direction (change stacking or switch to a higher payload vehicle).
map.计划装载校验：按计划件数计算总体积与总重量及对应利用率，超过体积上限标「超装」、: Planned loading check: from the planned piece count compute total volume, total weight and the utilization rates; over the volume ceiling is marked 'over volume', over the weight ceiling 'over weight', and utilization above 90% 'near full load', for reviewing before dispatch whether to add a truck or reduce the load.
map.算例：6.8 m 厢车装 0.6×0.4×0.5 m 纸箱: Worked example: a 6.8 m van loaded with 0.6 × 0.4 × 0.5 m cartons
map.：输入：车厢 6.8×2.3×2.4 m（容积 37.536 m³）、载重 50: : input: cargo box 6.8 × 2.3 × 2.4 m (volume 37.536 m³), payload 5000 kg; cartons 0.6 × 0.4 × 0.5 m (0.12 m³ each), 15 kg each; planned 500 pieces. Three orientations: (0.6,0.4,0.5) -> 11 × 5 × 4 = 220 pieces, (0.6,0.5,0.4) -> 11 × 4 × 6 = 264 pieces, (0.4,0.5,0.6) -> 17 × 4 × 4 = 272 pieces, take the max 272. Weight ceiling = floor(5000 ÷ 15) = 333 pieces. Maximum pieces = min(272, 333) = 272, binding type = volume limited; at 272 pieces volume utilization is 87.0% and weight utilization 81.6%. The planned 500 pieces need 60.00 m³ (159.8%) and 7500 kg (150.0%), over both volume and weight limits, so split into two trucks or reduce; if changed to 300 pieces then 36.00 m³ (95.9%) and 4500 kg (90.0%), still above the 272-piece volume ceiling, so it still will not fit.
map.为什么每个方向用向下取整而不是四舍五入？: Why round down rather than to nearest in every direction?
map.车厢三边不可切分，任一方向只能放下整数件，向下取整保证不越界。同时实际装车还要扣: The three sides of the cargo box cannot be split, and each direction can only hold whole pieces, so rounding down guarantees no overrun. Actual loading also has to deduct pallet thickness, cargo gaps, door frame inset and stacking error, so multiply the tool result by a 0.90-0.95 real-load factor as an executable loading plan.
map.只试 3 种摆放取向够吗？长方体不是有 6 种吗？: Is testing only 3 orientations enough? Doesn't a cuboid have 6?
map.长方体正交摆放确有 6 种，但绕竖直轴旋转 180° 只是交换另外两边，在向下取: A cuboid does have 6 orthogonal orientations, but rotating 180° about the vertical axis merely swaps the other two sides, which in a floor-counting model is equivalent to one already enumerated, so 3 orientations cover all distinct side assignments. If the goods may not be inverted (for example cartons marked 'this side up'), manually remove orientations that turn the original height into the vertical direction.

map.本工具纯前端运行，输入内容不上传服务器；结果为按上述口径得到的理论估算值。实际应: This tool runs entirely in the browser and does not upload inputs. Results are theoretical estimates using the method above. Actual use depends on equipment parameters, measurement conditions and local standards; refer to equipment nameplates, test reports and current standards, and consult professionals for major decisions.
map.最大可装件数（体积侧）：枚举 6 种正交摆放取向，分别计算 floor(车厢长÷: Maximum piece count (volume side): enumerate 6 orthogonal orientations, compute floor(vehicle length ÷ first edge) × floor(vehicle width ÷ second edge) × floor(vehicle height ÷ third edge) for each, and take the largest as the volume limit. This limit is only a uniform-orientation grid estimate and does not search mixed orientations.
map.计划装载校验：计划件数须为 0 或正整数，按计划件数计算总体积与总重量及对应利用: Planned loading check: the planned quantity must be 0 or a positive integer. Compute total volume, total weight and their utilization; mark volume over the limit as "over volume" and weight over the limit as "overweight", and utilization above 90% as "near full". The result only shows whether the volume/weight limits are exceeded; it is not a real loading-safety conclusion after stacking strength, gaps, axle load and lashing.
map.工具实际枚举 6 种全排列。绕竖直轴旋转 180° 虽然交换另外两边，但在统一朝: The tool actually enumerates all 6 permutations. A 180° rotation about the vertical axis swaps the other two edges, but in a uniform-orientation grid it corresponds to another edge allocation, so all permutations must be enumerated. If the cargo must not be inverted, manually remove orientations that put the original height edge vertical. The result is still only a uniform-orientation grid estimate and does not search mixed orientations.
map.最大可装件数（体积侧）：按所选方向（全部 6 种 / 仅保持原高度 / 固定朝向: Maximum piece count (volume side): with the selected orientation mode (all 6 / keep original height only / fixed), enumerate orthogonal placements and compute floor(body length ÷ (first edge + gap)) × floor(body width ÷ (second edge + gap)) × floor(body height ÷ (third edge + gap)); then cap the height layers by the maximum stack layers and carton compression limit, and take the maximum as the volume/orientation ceiling. It remains a uniform-orientation grid estimate and does not search mixed orientations in one body.
map.重量约束与受限类型判定：重量上限件数=floor(车辆载重×允许载重利用率上限÷: Weight limit and binding type: weight-limited pieces = floor(vehicle payload × allowed payload utilization cap ÷ unit weight); if an axle/local load limit is entered, also take floor(axle limit ÷ unit weight). Final maximum = min(volume/orientation ceiling, weight ceiling, axle ceiling), and whichever binds determines "volume/orientation limited", "weight limited" or "axle/local-load limited". The axle limit is converted to pieces only and does not verify actual front/rear axle distribution.
map.计划装载校验：计划件数须为 0 或正整数，按计划件数计算总体积与总重量及对应利用: Planned loading check: the planned quantity must be 0 or a positive integer. Compute total volume, total weight and utilization; volume over the ceiling is "over volume", weight over the ceiling is "overweight", and utilization above 90% is "near full". Stack layers, carton compression and gaps are now converted from inputs, but pallet thickness, door-frame inset, lashing and actual front/rear axle distribution are not modeled; the result only shows whether the volume/weight/axle limits are exceeded, not a real loading-safety conclusion.
map.：输入：车厢 6.8×2.3×2.4 m（容积 37.536 m³）、载重 50: : input: body 6.8 × 2.3 × 2.4 m (volume 37.536 m³), payload 5000 kg; cartons 0.6 × 0.4 × 0.5 m (0.12 m³ each), 15 kg each; planned 500 pieces. With defaults (all orientations, 0 gap, unlimited stacking, 100% payload cap, no axle limit), three representative orientations give (0.6,0.4,0.5) → 11×5×4 = 220 pieces, (0.6,0.5,0.4) → 11×4×6 = 264 pieces, and (0.4,0.5,0.6) → 17×4×4 = 272 pieces, so the maximum is 272. Weight ceiling = floor(5000 × 100% ÷ 15) = 333 pieces. Maximum loadable = min(272, 333) = 272, binding type = volume limited; at 272 pieces volume utilization is 87.0% and weight utilization 81.6%. The planned 500 pieces need 60.00 m³ (159.8%) and 7500 kg (150.0%), exceeding both, so split into two trucks or reduce the load; 300 pieces needs 36.00 m³ (95.9%) and 4500 kg (90.0%), still above the 272-piece ceiling, so it will not fit.
map.工具实际枚举 6 种全排列。绕竖直轴旋转 180° 虽然交换另外两边，但在统一朝: The tool enumerates all 6 permutations by default. A 180° rotation about the vertical axis swaps the other two edges, but in a uniform-orientation grid it corresponds to another edge allocation, so all permutations must be enumerated. If the cargo may not be inverted, set "Allowed orientations" to "Keep original height only" to try the two horizontal rotations; choosing "Fixed current orientation" disables rotation. The result is still only a uniform-orientation grid estimate and does not search mixed orientations.
